svg.title: Infrared absorption bands at Earth column amounts
svg.desc: Water vapour saturates below 600 and above 1300 inverse centimetres; carbon dioxide blocks 600 to 790; ozone forms an isolated band near 1055 inside the window; methane and nitrous oxide are weak near 1300.
svg.text: Band-averaged absorptivity, 1 − e^(−τ), from HITRAN lines at observed Earth columns · shaded 800–1250 cm⁻¹ is the atmospheric window · no continuum
